all.name: f
all.description: Frequency of sine function to invoke clutch1

all.name: J1.w
all.description: Absolute angular velocity of component (= der(phi))

all.description: der(Absolute angular velocity of component (= der(phi)))

all.name: J1.a
all.description: Absolute angular acceleration of component (= der(w))

all.name: clutch1.phi_nominal
all.description: Nominal value of phi_rel (used for scaling)

all.name: clutch1.mu_pos[1,1]
all.description: Positive sliding friction coefficient [-] as function of w_rel [rad/s] (w_rel>=0)

all.name: clutch1.mu_pos[1,2]
all.description: Positive sliding friction coefficient [-] as function of w_rel [rad/s] (w_rel>=0)

all.name: clutch1.peak
all.description: Peak for maximum value of mu at w==0 (mu0_max = peak*mu_pos[1,2])

all.name: clutch1.cgeo
all.description: Geometry constant containing friction distribution assumption

all.name: clutch1.w_small
all.description: Relative angular velocity near to zero if jumps due to a reinit(..) of the velocity can occur (set to low value only if such impulses can occur)

all.name: clutch1.w_relfric
all.description: Relative angular velocity between frictional surfaces

all.name: clutch1.a_relfric
all.description: Relative angular acceleration between frictional surfaces

all.name: clutch1.tau0

all.name: clutch1.tau0_max
all.description: Maximum friction torque for w_relfric=0 and locked

all.name: clutch1.free
all.description: = true, if frictional element is not active

all.name: clutch1.sa
all.description: Path parameter of friction characteristic tau = f(a_relfric)

all.name: clutch1.startForward

all.name: clutch1.startBackward
all.description: = true, if w_relfric=0 and start of backward sliding

all.name: clutch1.locked
all.description: = true, if w_rel=0 and not sliding

all.name: clutch1.Unknown
all.description: Value of mode is not known

all.name: clutch1.Stuck
all.description: w_relfric = 0 (forward sliding, locked or backward sliding)

all.name: clutch1.mode
all.description: Mode of friction (-1: backward sliding, 0: stuck, 1: forward sliding, 2: inactive, 3: unknown)

all.name: clutch1.lossPower
all.description: Loss power leaving component via heatPort (> 0, if heat is flowing out of component)

all.name: clutch1.mu0
all.description: Friction coefficient for w=0 and forward sliding

all.name: clutch1.f_normalized

prompt.task: Propose a reasonable reproducible usage scenario for probing FMU behavior.
constraints: Select up to 3 representative inputs and up to 5 representative outputs by exact name.
Scenario must include step, ramp, sine excitations.
Do not invent variables not in the list.
